name: Hangman Duel
description: Sealed-tick competitive Hangman. Both players race to reveal the SAME secret word by guessing letters one at a time. Each round, both players submit a single letter SEALED (neither sees the other's pick until both have submitted). Then both letters are revealed against the target. Correct letters reveal every matching position on that player's board; wrong letters add a strike. Player wins by FULLY revealing the word before reaching `max_strikes`. Hitting `max_strikes` first = loss. Configurable: best-of-N match length (default 1 = single game) and max strikes per game (default 6, matching classic Hangman). Chat is DISABLED — players don't see each other's reasoning. Per-seat opener mandate guarantees the two AI players start from different letters.

phases.name: play
phases.description: Both players submit one letter per round. Round resolves when both have submitted.

entity_types.name: HangmanDuelPlayer
entity_types.description: A Hangman Duel player. Sees their own mask (revealed letters + blanks), their own strike count, and the letters they've already tried. Picks ONE new letter per round.

properties.name: color
properties.description: Seat: 'white' (first-listed) or 'black' (second). Both players are equally active each round.

properties.name: strikes
properties.description: Wrong-letter count for this player. At max_strikes the player loses.

properties.name: letters_revealed
properties.description: Number of unique target letters this player has correctly revealed.

properties.name: solved
properties.description: True once this player has revealed every letter in the target word.

properties.name: frequency_bias
properties.description: 0 = ignores letter frequency; 1 = always picks the highest-frequency unguessed letter.

properties.name: risk_appetite
properties.description: 0 = always probes vowels & common consonants; 1 = takes early flyers on rare letters when context suggests them.

actions.name: guess_letter
actions.description: Submit your letter guess for the current round. REQUIRED parameter `letter` — a single alphabetic character (case-insensitive). Sealed: your opponent does NOT see your pick until both players have submitted. After both submit, both letters are revealed against the target word simultaneously. A letter you've already guessed in this game is rejected — pick a NEW letter every round.

parameters.name: letter
parameters.description: A single letter a-z to guess.

agent_archetypes.name: Frequency Optimizer
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Plays canonical Hangman frequency strategy — opens with the high-information vowels and common consonants (E, T, A, O, I, N, S, H, R), pivots once the mask reveals enough structure. Almost never guesses a rare letter early.

agent_archetypes.name: Pattern Reader
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Reads the partial mask aggressively — once a few letters are revealed, picks letters that complete plausible English words rather than maximizing raw frequency. Strong when the word fits common patterns (e.g. -ATION, -ING, double letters).

agent_archetypes.name: Balanced Solver
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Hybrid — frequency-first for the first 3-4 guesses, then switches to pattern matching once the mask exposes word shape.

agent_archetypes.name: Risk-Taker
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Goes for rare letters early when the mask hints at them (e.g. seeing 'Q_' bets on U; 'X' if pattern suggests EXIT/AXIS). Big wins or fast strikeouts.

runtime_parameters.name: domain.max_strikes
runtime_parameters.label: Max strikes per game
runtime_parameters.description: How many wrong-letter strikes each player gets before losing the game. Classic Hangman uses 6 (head, body, two arms, two legs).

runtime_parameters.name: wins_needed
runtime_parameters.label: Games to Win Match
runtime_parameters.description: Games a player must win to take the match. 1 = best of 1, 2 = best of 3, 3 = best of 5. Tied best-of-N goes to sudden death.

runtime_parameters.name: premise
runtime_parameters.label: Scenario Premise
runtime_parameters.description: Optional framing — e.g. 'speed-deduction tournament' or 'word-shape championship'.

termination_conditions.name: match_won
termination_conditions.description: End the match when a player clinches the best-of-N.
